facts.value: Prepare for the future you envision by transforming your varied passions into marketable expertise. You'll bridge two specific areas of interest through curated concentrations that combine learning with hands-on capstone experiences.

The core curriculum provides you with the intellectual tools to integrate your concentration areas, engage in transdisciplinary problem-solving, and prepare for careers and graduate programs that increasingly cross disciplinary boundaries.
business and project management, psychology and social welfare, communication and justice studies, public administration and ethics, digital culture and computer gaming
written communication, versatility, self-assessment, critical thinking
MAT 114 - College Mathematics or any math course that meets the MATH designation
This program is offered as an accelerated bachelor's plus master's degree.

There are no additional requirements for current ASU students to change their major to interdisciplinary studies; however, students interested in this major are highly encouraged to meet with an advisor.

Studying and interning abroad can be among the most valuable experiences for interdisciplinary studies students. With more than 300 Global Education program opportunities available, interdisciplinary studies students can tailor their experience to their specific interests and skill sets.

archivist or curator, climate change analyst, compliance manager, computer network support specialist, editor or web developer, environmental restoration planner, general and operations manager, higher education professional, regulatory affairs manager, wholesale and retail buyer (except farm products)

One graduate combined business and communication and now owns a small business; another integrated sociology and family studies to further a career in law enforcement; another studied philosophy and economics to prepare for law school; another combined biology and chemistry in preparation to pursue a Master of Pharmacy; and yet another studied Spanish and religious studies and now works as an employee trainer for a major company.
